# gotzji v1.0.0 release checklist

**Current version:** `v1.0.0`. Release target is gotzji v1.0.0; no official gotzji release exists yet. Follow [the canonical release process](../docs/development/RELEASE_PROCESS.md).

Every record must identify exact source/build/catalog, scope, scenario, observed outcome and evidence digest. States: PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, NOT_RUN, STALE; G15 alone is NOT_REQUIRED by the owner's 2026-10-17 decision. A component test does not close a runtime gate. Private operator/account/artifact evidence stays outside public source. Required domains cannot be waived by marking their entire implementation unsupported.

| Gate | Required observation |
|---|---|
| G01 | One isolated owner, host/native Goal/job history; original lnwjud unaffected |
| G02 | Honest complete tool/capability/workflow census; the owner's current ChatGPT account controls typed host-direct effects with no additional Claude/Grace/Codex/local-secondary inference backend, provider login, subscription or model |
| G03 | Actionable errors and scope/evidence/delivery guards |
| G04 | Durable admission, progress, history, result and retention after reopen |
| G05 | Normal exact-byte file/code/reviewed-command workflow |
| G06 | Two useful overlapping independent jobs and conflicting third waiter |
| G07 | Queue quotas/fairness/dependencies and selective owned cancellation |
| G08 | Replay/recovery without duplicated effects or lost authority |
| G09 | Actual browser granular interaction and workflow |
| G10 | Excel range/formula/table/chart/image preservation and workflow |
| G11 | Word and PowerPoint object/workflow preservation |
| G12 | CAD entities/layers/measurement/edit/save/reopen and original preservation |
| G13 | One durable authority for canonical Library skills/spokes/audit/privacy/write-back under an explicit ChatGPT reasoning/artifact-continuation contract across both explicitly enrolled routes |
| G14 | Actual ChatGPT Pro account/workspace/granular/workflow/reconnect |
| G15 | NOT_REQUIRED: separate Plus qualification removed by owner on 2026-10-17; retain the fixed owner-decision receipt, never label this a Plus PASS |
| G16 | Exact installed 1-2h useful parallel work with interruptions/Windows restart |
| G17 | Clean version/runtime/licence/trust and exact installer/portable inventory |
| G18 | Fresh owner/machine; N-1 migration, compatible update/rollback and uninstall |
| G19 | Accepted 3-day/20-job pilot plus final standards/spec/scrutiny/security review |
| G20 | Owner publication and independent download/hash/install/plugin verification |

The 18 required pre-publication gates G01-G14 and G16-G19 must pass before declaring the candidate qualified for publication. Keep all 19 declaration rows, with G15 NOT_REQUIRED and decisionId `owner-plus-acceptance-not-required-2026-10-17`, reviewer `owner`, observedAt `2026-10-17T00:46:08+07:00`, accountPlan `Plus` and one `owner-decision` receipt SHA-256 `a8c53c7c66714259d8bd02cd53f0dbdbffa1eb948769a3bd0d788f6fa5d86895`. This records scope, not Plus/Pro feature equivalence or a Plus test. G20 is the observed post-publication gate. G13 remains mandatory: model-dependent Library workflows are currently unsupported and cannot become PASS until the ChatGPT-driven contract is implemented and observed end to end. Missing external evidence never becomes PASS. Current source tests, provider fixtures and waiting-account facts are tracked separately; this checklist itself is not acceptance evidence.
